categories_macro_empty_subtitle: Create the first macro category to get started

categories_store_macro_create_descriptio: Enter the name of the new store macro category.

categories_store_edit_description: Edit the name and macro of the selected category.

holidays_empty_subtitle: Create the first holiday to get started

holidays_delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? Linked store opt-outs will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
characteristics_import_description: Upload a CSV file to create or fix the dictionary in bulk.
characteristics_import_hint: Expected headers: name, data_type, unit, options (separated by |). Existing entries are updated; a type change on an entry with values is rejected and must be done here.
characteristics_empty_subtitle: Create the first characteristic or import the dictionary from CSV
characteristics_create_description: Choose a name and type. Fixed lists need at least one option.
characteristics_edit_description: Edit the characteristic's name, type, unit and options.
characteristics_delete_with_values: "{name}" has values on {count} products: they will be permanently deleted, along with the characteristic and its subcategory assignments.
characteristics_delete_with_values_one: "{name}" has values on {count} product: they will be permanently deleted, along with the characteristic and its subcategory assignments.
characteristics_delete_description: Are you sure you want to delete the characteristic "{name}"? It will be removed from all subcategories. This action cannot be undone.
characteristics_type_change_hint: Changing the type deletes the values already filled in on {count} products.
characteristics_type_change_hint_one: Changing the type deletes the values already filled in on {count} product.
characteristics_unit_hint: Optional. Changing it doesn't convert values already entered.
characteristics_options_hint: Renaming an option keeps product values; removing it deletes them.
characteristics_confirm_type_change: Changing the type will permanently delete the values already filled in on {count} products.
characteristics_confirm_type_change_one: Changing the type will permanently delete the values already filled in on {count} product.
characteristics_confirm_options_removed: The removed options are in use: {count} products will lose their value, which will be permanently deleted.
characteristics_confirm_options_removed_: The removed options are in use: {count} product will lose its value, which will be permanently deleted.
characteristics_unit_too_long: The unit of measure can't exceed 20 characters
characteristics_option_too_long: The option value can't exceed 100 characters
characteristics_options_required: A fixed list needs at least one option
characteristics_matrix_description: {macro} · Choose which characteristics the seller fills in for products in this subcategory.
characteristics_matrix_empty_included: No characteristics included in this subcategory.
characteristics_remove_description: This characteristic has values on {count} products in this subcategory: they will be permanently deleted.
characteristics_remove_description_one: This characteristic has values on {count} product in this subcategory: they will be permanently deleted.
